build_swin_backbone: build a Swin Transformer backbone with forward hooks and postprocess modules for feature extraction
forward_swin_features: forward a tensor through a pretrained Swin backbone and return four layer activations
register_activation_hooks: register forward hooks on Swin layer blocks to capture intermediate activations by name
create_postprocess_modules: create Transpose and Unflatten postprocess modules to reshape Swin activations to spatial tensors
review_swin_backbone_config: review the Swin backbone hook indices and patch grid size configuration for feature extraction
